source.title: Efficacy and safety of glucose-lowering agents in patients with type 2 diabetes: A network meta-analysis of randomized, active comparator-controlled trials

source_integrity_flags: Figure 2 panels B and C display identical 52-week and 104-week add-on sensitivity estimates and identical H=1.425.

Figure 3 caption/panel labels and main-text cross-references do not map cleanly to the displayed secondary-outcome plots; only clearly identifiable BMI, severe-hypoglycemia, and nausea result sets were atomized.
Supplementary Table 7S is labeled 104 weeks but duplicates Table 5S 12-week metformin-reference values and conflicts with main Figure 1 Panel E.
extraction_limitations: Reference-list entries were not atomized; they are provenance/task-queue infrastructure.

Direct-comparison forest plots in Supplementary Figures 6S-13S were reconciled in coverage but not exhaustively converted into row-level atoms because the primary network estimates are the central claims.
The ambiguous extra WMD panel in Figure 3 was not assigned an endpoint or converted into a quantitative atom.
